svg.text: Cut four 25 mm lengths of 25 x 25 x 3 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rail leg: one 6.5 mm hole 10 mm from the leg's free end and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12.5 mm up (centred on the 25 mm length).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross member leg: one 6.5 mm hole 12.5 mm from its free end, 12.5 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The four clips are the same; a left one is a right one turned over.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one leg flat on the inside face of a rail, the other flat on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear face of a cross member, heel in the corner. The rail-leg bolt

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: also holds a hopper upright (opener clips) or goes alone (middle).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both legs sit flat with the cross member square to the rail.
